payload.claim: The spend-rollup subquery `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd_est), 0.0) FROM attempts WHERE task_id = ?` is restated verbatim here in the `task_package` fold branch, duplicating the identical subquery already written at line 814 in the `task_state` branch. `set_task_state`'s docstring (ledger.py:1433-1436) says the figure 'can never disagree with the rows it is made of' precisely because it is derived rather than passed, but that guarantee now rests on two independently written copies of the same formula staying in lockstep rather than on one shared source — the CLAUDE.md standard this review checks for ('a type, a constant or a helper the repository already defines imported, rather than restated') is exactly what the new branch's own comment ('Rolls the spend up the same way `task_state` does') concedes it does not follow. A person should decide whether to factor this into one shared SQL fragment or helper.
